meta_description: Ziggy Locksmith provides fast emergency locksmith services across Manchester. Locked out? We arrive within the hour. Call now for immediate help.
hero_subhead: Locked out of your home or office? Ziggy arrives within 60 minutes, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From burst locks to emergency access, we handle every lockout situation quickly and professionally.

services.title: Emergency lockout response
services.desc: Locked out of your home or flat? We attend most callouts within 60 minutes and gain entry without damage where possible. Available 24/7.

services.title: Lock replacement and repair
services.desc: Broken locks, worn keys, or seized mechanisms fixed or replaced same day. We fit high-security locks for extra peace of mind.

services.title: Commercial lockouts
services.desc: Business locked up? We prioritise commercial callouts with rapid attendance. Perfect for offices, shops, and industrial units.

services.title: Burglary damage repair
services.desc: Forced entry? We make your property secure again with emergency repairs and new locks installed the same day.

services.title: Vehicle unlocking
services.desc: Keys locked inside your car? We unlock vehicles swiftly without damaging locks or windows.

services.title: Lock fitting for new properties
services.desc: Moving home or office? We install new locks to your specification and provide spare keys.

about_pullquote: I got into this trade because being locked out is genuinely distressing—I wanted to help.
about_para_1: Ziggy Locksmith has been serving Manchester for over 15 years. Based in Abbey Hey, we've built our reputation on fast response times and honest pricing. Every technician carries a full range of locks and tools on the van, so most jobs are completed on the first visit without a follow-up charge.
about_para_2: We specialise in emergency callouts because we know a lockout can ruin your day. Whether it's 3am on a Sunday or Tuesday lunchtime, you'll get the same friendly, professional service. Most customers call us back because they trust us—and because word-of-mouth from happy clients is how we've grown.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About Ziggy

reviews.text: Locked myself out on Christmas Eve—absolute nightmare. Called Ziggy at 4pm and he was here by 5:15. Sorted the lock, didn't charge extra for the late callout either. Lifesaver. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: James P.

reviews.text: My son got locked in the garage. Ziggy arrived in under an hour, was calm and quick. Got him out safely and fixed the mechanism so it won't happen again. Highly recommended—fair prices too.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Office locked after hours and I had urgent paperwork needed. Ziggy answered at 9pm, arrived at 9:45, and we were back inside within 10 minutes. Professional, friendly, and no fuss. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Mark C.
